question:
A paper ribbon has length $36 \mathrm{~cm}$. It is divided into four rectangles of different lengths. Two lines are drawn, each joining the centres of two adjacent rectangles, as shown.
<image1>

A:$18 \mathrm{~cm}$
B:$17 \mathrm{~cm}$
C:$20 \mathrm{~cm}$
D:$19 \mathrm{~cm}$
E:It depends upon the sizes of the rectangles
